title: L-BFGS Local Refinement with ±12% Quarter-Wave Initialization (16L)
scientific_hypothesis: Constraining thickness initialization to ±12% of quarter-wave optical thickness at 10500 nm center wavelength, combined with L-BFGS local optimization, will refine phase alignment without expanding the thickness envelope and recover or exceed the Round 3 best score of 0.9057.
design_principle: Local gradient-based optimization from a physically-motivated starting point avoids random search inefficiency while maintaining proximity to the quarter-wave resonance condition that produced the best prior result.
proposed_topology: Air | (HfO2 | SiO2)_8 | Silicon substrate, 16 finite layers total, alternating sequence fixed
manufacturing_considerations: thickness bounds 200-1800 nm compatible with deposition processes
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack resonance at center of high-emissivity band
Kirchhoff's law relating absorptance to emissivity
Transfer Matrix Method for coherent multilayer optics
expected_advantages: Maintains proximity to proven high-performing configuration
Reduced risk of physics violations from extreme thickness values
known_risks: May converge to local optimum near initialization
Limited exploration of thickness space compared to global optimizers
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 stack on silicon substrate with air incidence. Initialize all layer thicknesses at quarter-wave optical thickness for 10500 nm center wavelength (HfO2 and SiO2 refractive indices at 10500 nm), then apply ±12% random perturbation to each layer. Use L-BFGS-B optimizer with thickness bounds 200-1800 nm per layer. Evaluate coherent TMM across 3000-13000 nm wavelength range at normal incidence. Objective: maximize weighted absorptance (high weight 8000-13000 nm, low weight 3000-5000 nm). Total layers fixed at 16, alternating HfO2/SiO2 sequence starting with HfO2 at air interface. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 3000-5000 nm, 8000-13000 nm. soft objectives: high emissivity in 8000-13000 nm; low emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: high emissivity in 3000-5000 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count not exceeding 24.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive to constrain initialization to ±12% of quarter-wave centers and replace random search with L-BFGS local optimizer for Round 5 refinement.
